args.sql:
WITH moyenne_globale AS (
    SELECT AVG(score) as avg_score
    FROM avis
),
utilisateurs_sup_moyenne AS (
    SELECT pseudo, score
    FROM avis a1
    INNER JOIN moyenne_globale mg ON 1 = 1
    WHERE a1.score > mg.avg_score
)
SELECT DISTINCT pseudo 
FROM utilisateurs_sup_moyenne
ORDER BY pseudo;

SELECT pseudo 
FROM avis a1
WHERE score > (SELECT AVG(score) FROM avis)
ORDER BY pseudo;

FROM avis a1

ORDER BY pseudo;

WITH concepts_root AS (
    SELECT c.idc, c.label
    FROM   "public".concept c
    WHERE  c.concept_pere IS NULL
),
concept_ouvrages AS (
    SELECT cr.idc, 
           COUNT(ak.ido) as nombre_ouvrage
    FROM   concepts_root cr
    INNER JOIN a_pour_mot_cle ak ON cr.idc = ak.idc
    GROUP BY cr.idc
)
SELECT c.label, co.nombre_ouvrage
FROM   concept_ouvrages co
LEFT JOIN "public".concept c ON co.idc = c.idc
ORDER  BY co.nombre_ouvrage DESC;
